name: DatamuseWord
description: Structural overview of a Word object returned by the Datamuse /words endpoint.

fields.name: word
fields.description: The matched word or short phrase.

fields.name: score
fields.description: Relationship-strength or popularity score within the result set.

fields.name: numSyllables
fields.description: Syllable count, returned when the md=s metadata flag is requested.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Lexical tags (POS codes, pron:..., f:...) returned for requested metadata flags.

fields.name: defs
fields.description: Definitions returned when md=d is requested; each entry is prefixed by its part-of-speech code.

fields.name: defHeadword
fields.description: Base headword form for inflected words.
